words.gloss: those who are united / close associates

literal: If discord arises among those who are united, at any time, not perishing is difficult to happen.
translation: If discord arises among those who are closely united, it is impossible for them to escape ruin at any time.
modern: நெருங்கிய நண்பர்களுக்கிடையே அல்லது உறவினர்களுக்கிடையே மனவேறுபாடு ஏற்பட்டால், அவர்கள் அழிவிலிருந்து தப்பிப்பது எக்காலத்திலும் இயலாததாகும்.
explanation: This couplet warns of the severe danger of internal division among close allies. The word 'onṟāmai' refers to discord or lack of unity, while 'onṟiyār' refers to those who are closely united. If such discord arises ('paṭiṉ') within a united group, escaping destruction ('poṉṟāmai') becomes impossible ('aritu') at any point in time ('eññāṉṟum'). The poet emphasizes that internal enmity is so destructive that survival is completely ruled out once unity is broken.
